Deconvolve runs using frozen HRFs learned from other runs

Source: R/crossrun_hrf.R
deconvolve_crossrun_hrf.Rd

Deconvolve runs using frozen HRFs learned from other runs

Usage

deconvolve_crossrun_hrf(
  bold,
  hrf_fit,
  lambda = NULL,
  scaling = "zscore",
  penalty = c("diff2", "diff1", "ridge", "matern1", "sobolev"),
  backend = c("cpp", "r", "wiener"),
  batch_size = 2048L,
  tail_padding = 0L,
  ridge_floor = 1e-08,
  operator_cache_mb = 128,
  nuisance_mode = NULL,
  observation_mask = NULL,
  lambda_grid = 10^seq(-2, 1, length.out = 16),
  gcv_rule = c("min", "1se")
)

Arguments

bold

Named time-by-voxel run matrices with IDs/order/dimensions matching the HRF fit. These should be the same preprocessed BOLD used for estimation.

hrf_fit

Object returned by estimate_crossrun_hrf().

lambda

Nonnegative regularization strength. If NULL (the default for modern ar1/calibrated fits), selected automatically from lambda_grid by gain-calibrated, task-weighted adaptive prewhitened generalized cross-validation using gcv_rule.

scaling

Input scaling: zscore (default), noise_sd, demean, none, or psc.

penalty

Quadratic penalty: diff2, diff1, ridge, matern1, or sobolev.

backend

Fixed linear inverse backend: cpp, r, or scalar wiener.

batch_size

Maximum voxel columns per scaling/multiplication block.

tail_padding

Number of appended zero BOLD observations, default zero. Use nrow(hrf_fit$kernels) to reproduce the current voxelwise wrapper assumption.

ridge_floor

Numerical diagonal ridge for cpp/r.

operator_cache_mb

Maximum inverse-operator cache size in MiB, default 128. Zero disables reuse across runs. A single operator may exceed the cache budget while it is being applied, but is not retained in the cache.

nuisance_mode

Jointly fit unpenalized intercept, trend, and supplied nuisance terms, or ignore them (default, preserving prepared input signals). Joint projection is applied to both data and design, but can amplify weakly identified low-frequency activity in a flexible continuous inverse. Validate it for the intended design rather than assuming it improves recovery.

observation_mask

Use fit's valid_rows in the inverse (fit), or all observations (all). Defaults to fit for AR/calibrated, all for OLS/legacy.

lambda_grid

Candidate regularization values evaluated when lambda = NULL.

gcv_rule

Selection rule ("min" or "1se") used when lambda = NULL.

Value

A list with activity matrices, per-run scaling/status tables, the HRF fit and frozen inverse settings. Activity matrices retain voxel IDs and carry tr and time_offset attributes for subsequent event alignment.

Details

One inverse operator is constructed per selected HRF/run length, cached for consecutive runs with identical masks/nuisance designs, and applied using block matrix products for cpp/r. Scalar Wiener uses direct block FFT fits. HRFs are frozen; no voxelwise factorization or R fitting loop is required. AR/calibrated fits use a masked GLS inverse with the frozen run-specific noise covariance. A gap of d acquisitions uses rho^d and the corresponding accumulated innovation variance. Censored rows contribute no observations; latent activity is still estimated on the complete original grid. Its observation_mask attribute identifies modeled versus observed samples. Nonfinite/constant signals on usable observations remain NA. Nonfinite censored observations do not invalidate a run. Joint nuisance fitting avoids projecting only the BOLD and inadvertently changing the task model. Wiener requires OLS, nuisance_mode = "ignore", observation_mask = "all". Scaling is applied once before optional padding, and its centers/divisors are returned. Different run z-scores do not preserve absolute between-run units.
